messages.author: 24987fb3fdada5f4
messages.subject: An error with RApache
parts:
Dear Freinds,

We would like develop an web service with R using RApache. I have
installed RApache and its dependencies. Also configured apache2 (Using
ubuntu).conf file. But when I restart apache2 I get following error

root@student-desktop:/etc# init.d/apache2 restart
* Restarting web server
apache2
[Tue Mar 29 17:16:05 2011] [warn] module R_module is already loaded,
skipping
Syntax error on line 11 of /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/000-default:
Invalid command 'Rlibrary', perhaps misspelled or defined by a module
not included in the server configuration

[fail]

My /etc/apache2/site-enabled/000-default has following information

<VirtualHost *:80>
ServerAdmin webmaster@localhost

DocumentRoot /var/www/
<Directory />
Options FollowSymLinks
AllowOverride None
</Directory>
<Location /test/R>
SetHandler r-handler
Rlibrary GDD
Rsource /var/www/html/test.R
RreqHandler handler
</Location>
</VirtualHost>

My /etc/apache2/apach2.conf file has following ifnormation

root@student-desktop:/etc# tail -10 apache2/apache2.conf
# Include generic snippets of statements
Include /etc/apache2/conf.d/
# Include the virtual host configurations:
Include /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/
ROutputErrors
LoadModule R_module /usr/lib/apache2/modules/mod_R.so

And Scripts are there in /var/www/html/test.R

Library(GDD ) is also installed properly.

Hence can you please let us know, why is it throwing error?

Regards,
Prashantha

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: An error with RApache
parts:
Hi Prashantha,

Looks like your configuration is calling the "LoadModule" directive
too many times. Scope out the files in /etc/apache2/mods-enabled/ and
see if it's not getting called there.

Also, RLibrary is not a valid directive for rApache. You could rewrite that as:

REvalOnStartup "library(GDD)"

Scope out http://www.rapache.net/manual.html for more info.

One more note: I would suggest using another graphics device besides
those found in GDD. The Cairo package is better. And also don't rule
out just using png(type='cairo') if png is all you need.

Best,

Jeff
